newsitem.title: USA: US Industries sells discontinued Jade Holdings.
newsitem.headline: US Industries sells discontinued Jade Holdings.

text.p: US Industries Inc said Monday that it sold Jade Holdings, a discontinued operation, to Twinbrook Capital Partners, a management and investment company in New Jersey. The sale and various real estate transactions earned proceeds of $16.4 million, the company said.
The sale of Jade Holdings included $4.5 million in cash plus a note totaling $2.4 million, the company said.
Because Jade Holdings was classified as a discontinued operation, no gain or loss will be recorded from the sale, the industrial management company said.
